A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same E2-LoRA paper with complete, readable text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A-C. Content can be reliably matched despite Figure 1's relocation and associated text reflow.

before.justification: v1 reports original class- and domain-incremental learning results in Tables 1-3, ablations in Tables 4-5, and supplementary empirical analyses in Appendix C.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark results, ablations, and Appendix C experiments, including the proxy-sampling comparison in Table 7.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithm 1 retain the same output-drift transformation, orthogonal subspace reuse, dynamic rank allocation, self-distillation, and classifier alignment. No algorithmic component or objective changes.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate ImageNet-R, CIFAR-100, CUB-200, Cars-196, Office-Home, and DomainNet. Longer task sequences and the single-class proxy-sampling scenario in Appendix C are also retained unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in corresponding tables and figures, including TUNA and MOS in Table 1, DCE and DUCT in Table 3, and O-LoRA and InfLoRA in Table 4.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendix B retain the same backbones, task splits, accuracy metrics, learning rates, training budgets, batch sizes, and domain-incremental prediction aggregation. No evaluation procedure changes.

E4.justification: The component ablations, rank-allocation comparison, proxy-size study, and longer-sequence evaluation are unchanged. Appendix C retains the same energy analyses, distillation-weight sensitivity study, and proxy-sampling robustness test.

E5.justification: Both versions specify three independent runs and report means and standard deviations. Figure 4 retains its three-run reporting, and no uncertainty-estimation or significance-testing procedure is added or revised.

E6.justification: Numerical results, plotted trends, and result entries are unchanged. For example, ImageNet-R Last-Acc remains 82.77±0.10 in Table 1 and 82.62±0.19 under the class-imbalance setting in Table 7.

T1.justification: Propositions 3.1 and 3.2, the method equations, and Appendix A's proofs are unchanged. Equation 6 moves from page 3 to page 4 without mathematical revision.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about concentrated output drift, optimal knowledge preservation under rank truncation, adaptive capacity allocation, and state-of-the-art performance.

C2.justification: The denoising interpretation, stability-plasticity explanations, and Appendix C interpretations remain unchanged. No substantive applicability boundary, failure condition, or limitation is added or removed.

D1.justification: v2 adds a code-availability statement and the kiddo127/E2-LoRA GitHub repository address to the abstract; v1 provides no code-access pointer. Implementation details and Appendix B settings remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works, reference list, and related-work discussion are unchanged. The positioning of output-drift orthogonalization relative to parameter-space and input-space approaches is retained.

P1.justification: The abstract gains one code-availability sentence, and the arXiv version/date stamp changes. Scientific prose, terminology, and section order otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 1 moves from page 1's right column to page 2's left column, with unchanged artwork and caption. Text and equations consequently reflow across the early pages; other figures and tables retain their content and design.

improvement.justification: The added repository pointer modestly improves reproducibility documentation by giving readers a concrete code-access location absent from v1. The PDFs do not establish the repository's completeness or usability. Scientific evidence and appendices are unchanged, and the limited layout changes introduce no substantive quality difference.
